senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בה , v. בהי; cmp. preced. ws.); Pi. בִּיהֵר or Hif. הִבְהִיר to shine brightly, be glossy; trnsf. to make one’s self conspicuous, to boast.
units: Lev. R. s. 15; Tanḥ. Thazr. 11 bahereth (Lev. XIII, 2) that is Yavan (Græco-Syria) שהיתה מְבָהֶרֶת על וכ׳ (or מַבְהֶרֶת) that lorded it over Israel by her decrees; v. קֶרֶן.—[Pi. בִּיהֵר to make clear.
